environment.scope: Fresh first-episode full-contact recovery evaluation; no fullS5 or hardware acceptance

draft.progression: Only policies that pass the original absolute and paired gates in the first frozen development batch may be assessed in the second. If both qualify in both batches, select the higher worst-pose combined success rate across them, then higher pooled actual-supine count. Unopened heldout requires a separate freeze after selection.
draft.source_contract: Same complete reset and 100-control physical release prefix. Two identical baseline repeats. Separate policy actions after release; common observation, raw-history, contact, handoff and hold definitions. Preserve original full eleven-second evidence and score without dynamic resets.

replication_draft.startup_contract: Before any sampled physics, verify weights, frozen scene, named initial state, controller, raw histories and exact process-local restore. Use only one sampled physical release, then restore all fields before each branch. Compare first control and first motor before physics exactly, and report repeat drift after the first substep.
replication_draft.comparison_contract: Use identical requested/actual four-pose, original timely/final hold and paired-supine gates as the first development run. Keep at least 32 actual samples each and 95% combined success overall and in each requested and actual pose, plus at least two actual-supine net wins versus each reference. If both pass both development runs, use the higher worst-pose combined rate across both runs, then pooled actual-supine count. Freeze a separate holdout only after selection.

teacher_head_draft.checkpoint_contract: Copy only the enveloped last output layer into the signed source checkpoint. Reset the actor optimizer state and counters for a new run, preserve critic parameters and optimizer, and validate exact source tensors, reload, and action agreement with the ONNX. This is a warm start, not an in-progress PPO resume.
teacher_head_draft.comparison_contract: Compare the same two parent repeats and the bounded teacher residual after a single shared release. Original all-pose and overall 95 percent timely plus final hold gates, minimum 32 actual scenes each, at least two actual-supine net wins against both repeats, and no net losses on non-supine actual poses. Before sampling require actual CUDA zero-step and the Windows-ready page. Original 11-second source clips and duplicate reference drift are archived.

latch.runtime: Latch only from the first actual observation after shared release. The two references use the same fixed parent. The candidate runs the bounded trained policy in latched supine scenes and returns exact parent actions for all other scenes. Audit the latch in native CUDA, then from saved actual observations independently replay both branches and the combined action at several controls. The original policy and controller interfaces are retained.
latch.gate: Original 95 percent timely and final hold in all requested and actual poses and overall, minimum 32 samples per actual pose, at least two actual-supine net gains against both references, and no net non-supine pose loss. Record repeated-reference drift and source 11-second original media. Require actual CUDA zero-step and Windows-ready observation before any sampling. Do not select from the final holdout.

corrected_ppo_evaluation.comparison: Use the same released physical state and fallback actor for all four branches. Both fixed repeats use the fitted warm-start actor for latched supine. The matched control and candidate use their own reloaded checkpoint exports for the same latched supine scenes. Compare the candidate to the control and both fixed repeats. Keep the old complete hold criteria and independent scoring. Only a candidate that passes all gates qualifies for a different development seed.
corrected_ppo_evaluation.required_preflight: Require independently reloaded training weights, matching sample draws, real original training footage, and accepted throughput for both arms. Verify all four latches on actual CUDA without a physics step, then verify the Windows observation route. Open no final holdout during development.

import_random_state: Preserve and assert CPU and CUDA random state for every model load

dual_route.scope: Use two copies of the same supine-routed PPO control as fixed repeats. The candidate additionally latches the previously validated right-side specialist from the first actual policy observation, with common fallback elsewhere. Verify native action parity and unchanged random streams. Retain the original full standing gates. Assess any non-right change against the repeated control and require the candidate to pass every original non-right gate. Use independent development confirmation for selection before the reserved holdout.

replication.scope: Replicate the already frozen dual route on an unseen development seed. Preserve the same three weight files, observation mask, reset distributions, camera rule, right-side net-gain requirement, 95-percent every-pose and overall gate, physics budget and runtime. Do not use the reserved holdout or tune on this run.
